title: UAC-0020 (Vermin) атакує Сили оборони України з використанням ШПЗ SPECTR в тандемі з легітимним SyncThing (кампанія "SickSync") (CERT-UA#9934)

entities.name: UAC-0020
entities.gloss: A cyber threat group linked to security structures in temporarily occupied Luhansk, also known as Vermin.

entities.name: Сили оборони України
entities.gloss: The military and security formations tasked with defending Ukraine against aggression.

entities.name: Центр кібербезпеки ЗСУ
entities.gloss: The cybersecurity defense unit operating within the Armed Forces of Ukraine.

entities.name: Україна
entities.gloss: A sovereign country located in Eastern Europe.

entities.name: SPECTR
entities.gloss: A modular malware framework used for information theft, credential harvesting, and surveillance.

entities.name: SyncThing
entities.gloss: A legitimate peer-to-peer file synchronization software application.

entities.name: InnoSetup
entities.gloss: A free installer generator utility for Windows operating systems.

entities.name: туррель.фоп.вовчок.rar
entities.gloss: A password-protected RAR archive distributed as a malicious email attachment.

entities.name: туррель.фоп.вовчок.sfx.rar.scr
entities.gloss: A malicious self-extracting archive containing lures and payload installers.

entities.name: Wowchok.pdf
entities.gloss: A decoy PDF document used to deceive victims during an attack.

entities.name: sync.exe
entities.gloss: A malicious installer packaging SyncThing components alongside SPECTR malware.

entities.name: run_user.bat
entities.gloss: A batch script designed to handle initial payload execution.

entities.name: syncthing.net
entities.gloss: The official internet domain associated with the SyncThing file synchronization software.

entities.name: csoc@post.mil.gov.ua
entities.gloss: An official contact email address for the Cyber Security Center of the Ukrainian Armed Forces.

relations.evidence: активність угрупування UAC-0020 (Vermin), спрямовану у відношенні Сил оборони України

relations.head: UAC-0020
relations.evidence: використано відомий з 2019 року інструментарій - шкідливе програмне забезпечення SPECTR

relations.head: UAC-0020
relations.evidence: використано штатний функціонал синхронізації легітимного програмного забезпечення SyncThing

relations.head: sync.exe
relations.evidence: файл "sync.exe" містить... файли шкідливих програм SPECTR
